title: alchemilla glabra subsp. obtusa
intro: Alchemilla glabra subsp. obtusa, commonly known as lady's mantle, is a perennial plant species within the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and alleviate menstrual cramps. The health benefits of Alchemilla glabra subsp. obtusa include soothing irritated skin, treating digestive issues, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
